description: Checks evidence contracts, not whether people or firms actually move to model winners. Matched, licensed outcome panels and held-out testing are required for calibration.

rows.cohort_requirement: Moves and retention of households with children, childcare coverage and cost, actual school access and housing burden.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Residual household resources after a fixed essential basket, access to suitable jobs without a car, retention and hardship outcomes.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Fixed two-adult low-income family scenario, with child costs and employment access measured separately.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Single-parent retention, childcare affordability and hours compatible with work, short reliable journeys and family-sized rentals.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Age-specific domestic migration and retention, plus pension-budget affordability, accessible healthcare and independent-living outcomes. Separate age proxy from confirmed retirement.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Older single-person household moves and retention; accessible housing, care and social participation.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Moves of non-employed adults below pension age where measurable; otherwise explicitly labelled age-based evidence, not retirement counts.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Single-adult housing affordability and retention, with career outcomes only for the career-oriented case.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Age 25-39 employment and migration, occupation-specific wages net of housing, and career retention.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Dual-earner child-free household migration and net resources where microdata permit; never substitute all young adults.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Remote-worker shares and persistence, verified home broadband reliability and cost, and residual budget.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Observed commuting flows and mode shares against scheduled and congestion-aware travel times.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Car-free household access to jobs, groceries and healthcare, including evenings, weekends and accessible routes.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Enrolment by actual teaching campus, student moves, accommodation burden and student transport access.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Ownership transitions and availability under a published standard financing and dwelling scenario, not house-price appreciation.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Total essential expenditure and access to jobs/services under a fixed modest budget; compare with low_income for redundancy.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Resident retention, actual cultural and service access, travel behaviour and net housing burden.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Skilled international arrivals and retention with a defined nationality/permit scenario; total foreign-born stock is not an annual flow.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Access to appropriate care, capacity, out-of-pocket burden and avoidable admissions; never infer clinical quality from a nearby hospital alone.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Accessible nature, air/water quality, ecological conditions and services, with household moves only as secondary evidence.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Rural retention, accessible services and broadband, local job reach and total transport-adjusted costs.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Official residence/tax cases and persistent high-value services; avoid opaque millionaire-migration estimates.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Use an explicitly defined wealth scenario and official municipal tax calculations, not an invented lottery-winner behavioural model.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Historical and forward-looking hazard exposure, insurance availability, adaptation and service continuity; migration alone cannot certify resilience.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Observed coastal household attraction and retention, public shoreline access and seasonal costs, separately from insurance/hazard risks.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Owner-manager residence outcomes plus access to the relevant enterprise network; no company feasibility claim from this household score.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Define digital occupation/working arrangement; otherwise compare redundancy and merge with a career or remote-work profile.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Sector-specific establishment openings, employment and survival, matched to operating-site capacity and logistics.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Warehouse/transport employment and openings, freight throughput, shipment time and delivery-market access.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Software employment and wages, business births/survival and skilled-worker retention; separate lagged ecosystem inputs from future outcomes.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Back-office establishment activity and retention, occupation-specific labour availability and wage/productivity measures.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Field-specific R&D employment, operating laboratories, research outputs and spinout survival.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Actual regional HQ employment and relocations, route/time-zone access and the relevant legal/tax operating scenario.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Cargo-specific throughput, port industrial employment and operating investment, with actual terminal links.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Retail establishment survival, expenditure and pedestrian catchment; compare like store types.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Food-service openings/survival, time-of-day footfall, tourism/daytime workers and comparable rents.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Trade-specific business activity, survival and demand in a drive-time catchment.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Unmet care demand, reimbursement, staffing, patient access and practice survival.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Creative-sector employment, business survival and project/commission demand.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Sector-specific new employer firms, survival, scaled employment and verified financing, with non-employer shells separated.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Official guest nights, occupancy and seasonality, lodging supply and business survival.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Operating sector capacity and realised investment, industrial tariffs, firm grid access and utility reliability.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Operational commissioned MW and occupancy, enterprise fibre and actual grid connection lead time; announced projects are a separate series.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Authorised operating production sites, specialist employment and realised capacity, not patents or lab counts alone.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Operating food plants, agricultural input access, employment and throughput.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Fulfilment operations, last-mile delivery coverage and workforce availability.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Contact-centre employment and retention, verified language pools and wage/turnover costs.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Licensed banking establishments and jobs, client market and operating permissions.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Official wealth-management employment/authorised entities and client reach; private wealth estimates require a clear licence and method.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Authorised securities firms, market connectivity and specialist employment.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Licensed insurers, actuarial/underwriting employment, market access and operating substance.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Regulated fund management and administration activity, separated from legal domiciles and assets booked there.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Commodity trading employment and regulated/registered operating entities; cargo terminals only for physical operations.

rows.cohort_requirement: Authorised virtual-asset service activity and employment, not token prices, promotional rankings or corporate registrations alone.

rows.cohort_requirement: Only compare optional investment-office locations under a declared mandate, not sovereign fund domiciles.

rows.cohort_requirement: Actual public activity access, terrain suitability and safety, including non-mountain outdoor destinations.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Official cross-border commuting flows, crossing schedules and a fixed residence/work/tax/social-insurance case.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Finance employment and operating entities by subsector, plus role-specific authorisation and substance.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Operating fabs versus design offices versus assembly/test sites, with specialist staffing and realised capacity.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Automotive plants, suppliers, employment and realised expansions, using an explicit supplier tier and product case.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Aerospace operating sites, employment, certifications and supply-chain links.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Operational plants and realised capacity by product, with input materials, power and permitting.
rows.condition_scoring: fixed-weight screening; observations and proxies disclosed

rows.cohort_requirement: Media/games employment, commissioned production and business survival by subtype; announced projects are not operating activity.

rows.cohort_requirement: Unmet care demand, patient travel and payer coverage, authorisable capacity and clinical staffing, not population growth alone.
